points.description: Identifies a stack as a data structure (accept equivalent wording such as 'data type' or 'structure used to store data').
States that a stack stores elements/items/data (accept 'holds items' or similar).
States the last-in-first-out property: the last item added is the first to be removed, or equivalently uses the term LIFO / last-in-first-out. Do not award for FIFO/queue behaviour.

levels.says: States the LIFO ordering correctly but vaguely, e.g. says items are removed from the same end they are added, without stating the last-in-first-out relation.
Mentions last/first or LIFO but the relation is incomplete or partly incorrect.

rubric.notes: Full marks require identifying a stack as a data structure, saying it stores elements, and correctly stating the LIFO/last-in-first-out property. Award part marks on P3 for a vague or incomplete statement of the ordering; no marks on P3 for FIFO/queue behaviour. P1 and P2 are all-or-nothing.
